https://ryanuo.cc/en/posts/2021: Start planning your life early, strive harder, complain less, and remember opportunities are earned through personal effort. We spend nights awake, but merely scrolling through our phones, giving countless likes; we impulsively decide to learn something new, buy numerous vocabulary books that remain unopened thereafter; we get motivated to work out after being inspired, gather loads of workout plans but never execute them; we vow to read extensively, purchase stacks of books yet never crack one open. Sometimes, taking a wrong turn clarifies the future path; befriending the wrong people reveals the meaning of true friendship amidst hardship; loving the wrong person teaches us the essence of genuine love. However, to thrive in the world, relying solely on others' support isn't enough; you need to venture forth alone at times, enduring solitude to strengthen your wings, ultimately to protect and cherish those you don't want to leave behind.
